The following events took place in '''10 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
{{Quote|One Jedi cannot conquer the dark side alone&hellip; I guess we've proved that. But ''together'', we were a Jedi fire that outshone his evil.''"<br />"''Two are more powerful than one&hellip;''three'' are more powerful than two.|Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa Solo, after Palpatine's second death|audio=ForceHarmony-DE.flac|<ref name="DEaudio">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
*[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] united under the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]].
*The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was [[Second Battle of Coruscant|driven]] off [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="DE 1" /> and took refuge on [[Pinnacle Base]], located on [[Da Soocha V]].<ref name="DE 2" />
*[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] returned in a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body and revealed his [[Dark Empire]] to the New Republic.<ref name="DE 2" />
*Palpatine killed [[Arden Lyn]].<ref name="jvs">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
*Amidst the chaos, neutral [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] formed protective federations such as the [[Dawferim Selfhood States]] and [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]]. [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] instituted home rule.
*Fulfilling the prophecy of [[Bodo Baas's Master]],<ref name="DE 6">[[Dark Empire 6|''Dark Empire'' 6]]</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] pledged himself to the reborn Palpatine,<ref name="DE 2" /> but was soon turned back by his sister, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], and they destroyed Palpatine.<ref name="DE 6" />
*Leia Organa Solo took the [[Tedryn Holocron]] from the resurrected Palpatine.<ref name="DE 5">[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]]</ref>
*New Republic hero [[Kyle Katarn]] prevented an [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] against [[Altyr V]].
*[[The Force/Legends|Force]] adept [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] turned Kyle Katarn away from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
*Palpatine destroyed [[Vima-Da-Boda's lightsaber]] on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="DE 4">[[Dark Empire 4|''Dark Empire'' 4]]</ref>
*Luke Skywalker turned former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] Jedi [[Kam Solusar]] away from the dark side.<ref name="DE II 1 crawl">[[Dark Empire II 1|''Dark Empire II'' 1]] opening crawl</ref>
*[[Destruction of Da Soocha V|Destruction]] of [[Da Soocha V]] by the [[Galaxy Gun]]<ref name="DE II 5">[[Dark Empire II 5|''Dark Empire II'' 5]]</ref> forced the New Republic to relocate to the [[Nespis VIII|Space City]] over [[Nespis VIII]].<ref name="DE II 6">[[Dark Empire II 6|''Dark Empire II'' 6]]</ref>
*[[Destruction of the Nespis VIII spaceport|Destruction]] of the Space City along with the ''[[Pelagia]]'' by the Galaxy Gun.<ref name="EE1">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]]</ref>
*[[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] was [[Battle of New Alderaan (Operation Shadow Hand)|taken]] over by the Empire under the leadership of Palpatine.<ref name="DE II 6" />
*Pure-[[Blood/Legends|blooded]] [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] became extinct, despite the New Republic's best efforts to save them.
